About

A curious mind, from microbes to machines.

I am a third-year B.Sc. Microbiology student at MVM Science & Home Science College (Saurashtra University). I am developing my research skills through literature-based academic projects, laboratory training and scientific learning, and I am motivated to gain international research experience in life-science research.

Current interests

  • Gut microbiome & gut–brain axis
  • Psychobiotics, stress and mental health
  • Clinical microbiology & antimicrobial resistance
  • AI in life sciences

Work actually done

  • Ongoing independent literature review on the gut microbiome
  • Posters & presentations at national events
  • 1 week as Clinical Laboratory Trainee
  • Sample websites as a beginner designer

Future ambitions

  • International research experience
  • Microbiome and AI-assisted research
  • Growing my web design skills

Security & privacy
Privacy by design




What this site does
  • Sets no cookies of its own; no analytics or ad trackers.
  • Has no forms, logins or accounts and collects no personal data.
  • Loads fonts from Google Fonts, so your browser contacts Google when the page opens.
  • Renders all content as plain text and opens external links with noopener noreferrer.


What is public
  • The CV and certificate scans are embedded in this page: anyone who opens it can view and download them.
  • A hidden link is not a private link. Private files need server-side access control.
  • No phone number, home address or secrets are published.


Editing & admin
  • There is deliberately no admin panel here. Updates mean editing the data block and re-uploading.
  • Login-protected editing needs a real backend with authentication. Never put passwords or keys in frontend code.


Privacy Policy
This website collects no personal data and has no forms, accounts or analytics. If you email me, I receive the information you choose to send and use it only to reply. Your hosting provider and network may keep standard server logs (such as IP address and time), which this site does not control. Google Fonts is the only third-party resource; your browser requests it from Google when the page loads. This site sets no cookies itself. Last updated: October 2026. This is a plain-language summary, not legal advice.


Terms of Use
This site is a personal portfolio. Information about education, certificates and activities is accurate to my knowledge at the time of writing. The molecular diagrams are simplified educational models, not real microscopy images or experimental data. The listed websites are practice projects, not paid client work unless stated. Please do not copy text, images or documents without permission. External sites are run by third parties and I am not responsible for them. The site is provided as is, without warranty.
